full_judgment: 12. An inordinate delay has been caused in filing the civil revision against judgment of reversal whereas the trial Court decreed the suit on contest with elaborate discussion and the Appellate Court reversed the same ex-parte in a slipshod and perfunctory manner. The order sheet of the Appellate Court is annexed with the supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioners to their application for condonation of delay. It appears from the subsequent Order No. 18 dated 23-2-2005 that both parties filed hazira and LCR was received. On the same date the appeal was sent to the learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka for speedy disposal stating that- “দ্রুত নিষ্পত্তির জন্য অত্র মামলাটি বিজ্ঞ অতিঃ জেলা ও দায়রা জজ, ১ম আদালতের বদলি করা হইল।” Resultantly, the appeal was sent to the said Court of the learned Additional District
